notes: Colour truth comes only from target_prompt.txt and appearance.json; scene metadata and material names are not colour authority.
All semantic roots are retained for DF. Shared-colour entities are grouped in one attribute, fixed across all nine cells.
T1: target scarlet red -> red; AC magenta -> purple.
T2: target cobalt blue -> blue; AC burnt orange -> orange.
T3: target emerald green -> green; AC cyan -> blue.
Marble entity numbers are not their opening-image left-to-right order; colour binding follows appearance.json entity_id.
